column1: # Parameters for our own MC 15 MK scale model. Change ML and rebuild inside
# Every value comes from the RSF drawing "MC15 MK mating dimensions"
# ML is part of our part number: MB-MC15-MK-ML220 is a scale with a 220 mm
# measuring length. The tape is OL = ML + 20 mm long.

column9: Measuring length ML: the travel of the scanning head along the tape. Ordered by the customer
OL = ML + 20 +-0.2: the tape is this much longer than the measuring length
At the start of the measuring length the side of the scanning head is this far before the start of the tape
Position sensor: distance from the side of the scanning head (16.2 +-0.7)
Width of the steel tape scale (8 +-0.03; detail X)
